prompt:

Header text verbatim: "en svaghet". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "weakness".
Scene: A small tabletop model bridge with a clearly highlighted crack in one support, an engineer inspecting the weak point with a magnifying glass, no people on the model, no text.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "svaghet = weakness; the weak point needs support.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "En spricka är brons största svaghet.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
